name: bld
description: A .NET tool for managing MSBuild projects: clean build output, analyze NuGet packages, migrate target frameworks, and enable Central Package Management.

tools.name: bld_tfm_analyze
tools.description: Analyzes .NET projects and detects their current Target Framework(s). Returns a list of projects with their TFMs.

tools.name: bld_tfm_migrate
tools.description: Migrates .NET projects from one Target Framework to another.

tools.name: bld_nuget_analyze
tools.description: Analyzes NuGet package references across all projects in a solution.

tools.name: bld_outdated_check
tools.description: Checks for outdated NuGet packages and lists available updates.

tools.name: bld_outdated_update
tools.description: Updates outdated NuGet packages to their latest versions.

tools.name: bld_cpm_analyze
tools.description: Analyzes a solution for Central Package Management (CPM) conversion.

tools.name: bld_cpm_convert
tools.description: Converts a solution to Central Package Management (CPM).

tools.name: bld_clean_analyze
tools.description: Analyzes build output directories (bin/obj) for cleaning.
